name: bett3r-knowledge-store
description: Knowledge-store capture overlay for the bett3r-ai-workflow flow. Two hooks attach to the two moments worth recording: artifacts are captured synchronously right before `git worktree remove` destroys them, and a freshly-opened PR is captured and queued for extraction, detached. Ships no command and no skill — the base flow plugin stays store-agnostic, and a repo with no executable `.knowledge-store/capture` is byte-for-byte unaffected.
